Across its 63 WLC occurrences עצר means restrain, detain, shut up, imprison, and (עֲצָרָה) assembly; it shares the holding/withholding branch of ʿaṣr (¶14 ḥabs, ¶11 confinement) and uses it of heaven withholding rain, the reverse of the Arabic pressed rain clouds (¶8). It lacks the pressing/juice, refuge, whirlwind and time senses; the cupbearer's pressing in Gen 40:11 uses śāḥaṭ instead. The assembly sense (Lev 23:36, Joel 1:14) is a false friend for this page.

Sound correspondence only. All 8 WLC occurrences of צבר mean heap up (grain Gen 41:35, 41:49; frogs Exod 8:10; silver Job 27:16; Ps 39:7); none carries endurance, patience or the bitter pressed extract that ¶10 develops. The meeting of the consonants in Joseph's grain-heaping is a sound coincidence, recorded in an elenen block rather than used as evidence.
